The '''Mark IV Guardian Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Some of those droids were used by [[Stark]] aboard his ship, the ''[[Euphony]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
